'''DarthVader,AOE INVASION / Help Me Make This Deck Better-''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[DarthVader,AOE]]
* '''Published:''' 16 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Invasion
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Invasion DarthVader,AOE DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I've been working on this deck for a short period of time. I like that it's the less used objective and it seems to have it's own good strategies built in, but how can I make it better?

== Strategy ==

Flip objective as soon as possible.
After flipped, you can deploy only two Battle Droids to a site, battle with two battle destiny, Ghhhk them, and pull them back into your hand with Droid Racks on the next turn.
For defense, you can use Battle Droid Blaster Rifles which will be forfeited to used pile for 3 pts each with Inconsequential Losses.
With Search And Destroy, just control two Theed Sites with Battle Droids and deal extra damage each turn.

Dont' rate too harshly, I'm still a novice.

Thanks for the advice! Masterful Move should work very well as a decent recycling 6.
